integrity: The proof is analytic; the symbolic and finite checks are reproducible corroborations and do not establish the infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic, real symmetric two-step setting; embedding on span of the two Lanczos vectors plus the next residual. Sharpness is uniform over matrices with fixed consecutive Lanczos couplings and need not describe a fixed matrix with unequal Ritz diagonal terms. Independent external validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp embedding-distortion reality certificate for two-step sketched symmetric Lanczos
